problems.problem: The stride-echo mechanism is only half legible. Geometry and image 1 confirm both echoes now trail the heel (navy x=4, lime x=36, bases 979 on the rule at y=980), but the navy echo at opacity 0.34 over the #2E3134 sheet renders as a barely-visible dark band at the far left heel and as a faint tongue bump at ~(230,640); only the lime echo reads clearly. A two-frame stride needs two readable frames; today the poster shows one echo plus a smudge, so 'frames of a stride' still under-delivers.
problems.root_cause: Navy #1B2F4E at 0.34 opacity on a near-black field has insufficient value separation to function as an independent motion frame.
problems.repair_strategy: Raise the navy echo opacity to 0.55 (keep lime at 0.5) in one complete background.shapes set so both backward steps read as distinct ink densities on the charcoal sheet.

problems.problem: Vertical distribution is still unbalanced: the band y=140..560 carries nothing but empty charcoal, and the band y=990..1440 (31% of canvas height) is completely inert below the rule. The type column floats at mid-right with ~80px of dead space above the title and no element tying the column to the rule terminal at x=1004. References (Converse lockup hugging the hero, Puma's filled diagonal) keep negative space activated; here the emptiness is passive, not composed.
